svg.title: Stories of the past and future — the local-time corpus
svg.desc: Each entry is a work plotted at its publication date and how far its setting sits from that date: 535 entries, 464 obsolete, 8 still possible, 54 former period pieces, 9 recognisable past settings. Chart form after xkcd #1491.

g.aria-label: the cone: settings the reader's present has overtaken
g.text: and older than this, the future is already past
